fusions.name: Undercut
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health: the bite deals 18 damage, consumes every affliction on the target and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage, and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Ankle-High Sweep
fusions.desc: Chops low across everything within 2.5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 4 damage and leaving each target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Dropped Timber
fusions.desc: Drops a felled trunk across the ground as a barrier 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Widening Kerf
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes it for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (122% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
